:::{#exm-noise}
#### The noise of one new outcome

Suppose the [mean function](#def-mean-function) value at $\predvar$ is $\truemeanf{\predvar} = 5$.
A new outcome $\newoutvar = 5.3$ at $\predvar$ has [noise](#def-noise) $\noise = 5.3 - 5 = 0.3$.
A new outcome $\newoutvar = 4.6$ at $\predvar$ has noise $\noise = 4.6 - 5 = -0.4$.

:::
